profile.summary: A Fremont, California company, founded in 2003, that designs, installs and maintains security systems, mainly video surveillance (security cameras) and access control. It serves local governments, school districts and transportation agencies in Northern California. Convergint, a larger security company, acquired it in 2022.

sources.title: Convergint Expands Northern Calif. Presence With Ojo Technology Buy

review.notes: The cited SDM article confirms Ojo Technology is a Fremont, CA video surveillance and access control firm founded in 2003, serving Northern California cities, counties and most school districts, and acquired by Convergint in August 2022. This fits OUSD's Fremont-listed security camera maintenance agreement; the summary is neutral and the null contact fields are appropriate.
